title: S1-018 Profile-C MLS + attested indexer contract (authoritative, versioned)

hard_invariants.PC1: no plaintext outside boundary: plaintext/keys never reach host storage, logs, errors, bundle, trace or network payload outside the declared boundary
hard_invariants.PC2: gateway authority only: attestation and MLS membership never widen capability; final ALLOW/DENY belongs to the Gateway
hard_invariants.PC3: exact scope: tenant/goal/scope/member/query/result bindings exact; cross-scope reuse forbidden
hard_invariants.PC4: attestation complete: evidence checked against host-owned trust anchors, measurement/reference values, signer/product/security version, TCB status, appraisal-policy version and challenge nonce
hard_invariants.PC5: fresh non-replay: stale/replayed evidence or reused nonce never opens a session; unknown freshness fails closed
hard_invariants.PC6: session binding: attested session binds exact scope, member, group epoch, index epoch, measurement, policy version and expiry
hard_invariants.PC7: monotonic epoch: MLS/index/revocation epochs never roll back; sealed-state rollback and snapshot resurrection are detected
hard_invariants.PC8: revocation dominates cache: revoked member/token/session reads no new data even with warm cache/restart; S1-008 bound applies in the measured environment only
hard_invariants.PC9: key lifecycle: join/update/remove/rekey/expiry carry observable history; removed members get no new epoch/index keys
hard_invariants.PC10: result integrity: results bind exact query, partition, index epoch and corpus digest; forged/mixed/stale results denied
hard_invariants.PC11: unknown fails closed: malformed, unsupported, timeout, crash, missing endorsement/reference value yield DENY/QUARANTINE, never ALLOW
hard_invariants.PC12: no blind retry: unknown side effects reconcile first; retries are idempotent or compensated
hard_invariants.PC13: audit atomicity: security-relevant transition and audit evidence commit atomically or not at all
hard_invariants.PC14: leakage honesty: content/scope/query-equality/access-pattern/size/timing leakage measured separately; NO_DATA never becomes zero
hard_invariants.PC15: non-production: PoC output is not production qualification

time_model.clock: monotonic logical milliseconds owned by the simulator; UTC wall labels for audit only
time_model.t_commit: sole zero point of the revocation bound: durable commit of canonical revoked state + matching audit event
time_model.bound_scope: model-only bound in the measured simulator environment; never a production SLO

mock_quote_discipline.shape: measurement, TCB version, nonce, signer id, profile id (EAT-shape discipline, no EAT conformance)
mock_quote_discipline.hardware_tee_evidence: NOT_MEASURED always; a mock quote is never called hardware attestation
mock_quote_discipline.vectors: no public attestation test vectors executed; appraisal runs are protocol validation only

forbidden: encrypted index implying no metadata/access-pattern leakage
no found leak implying universal confidentiality
local latency called a production SLO
research verdict used as production approval or Goal ACCEPTED
